meta.what: stars with >= 2 valid fine-res (.0000) cadences on different MJD days in the same band
meta.evidence: archive metadata only - no signal search, no E-level

rules.epoch: one (project, MJD day, centre freq) session holding a valid cadence (bl_archive.cadences named-OFF, or targets.abacad ABACAD)
rules.same_band: telescope + band letter from the centre frequency (L 1-2, S 2-4, C 4-8, X 8-12 GHz)
rules.pointing_ok: max ON-scan pointing offset from the star propagated to the scan date <= half the GBT FWHM (12.45'/f_GHz)

checked.scope: targets.json's file-checked stars showing >= 2 same-band dates, GJ699 always, and every star targets.json had never file-checked

meta.source: Breakthrough Listen open data (Lebofsky et al. 2019, PASP 131, 124505)
